699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 description: I don’t waste introductions. If you’re working with me now, you’re expected to deliver — consistently. Power infrastructure around Tarkov is failing, and reliable electronics are worth more than ammunition to the right people. I need functional components recovered from active zones, not scrap pulled from old stashes. Find the parts in raid and hand them over intact. Consider this your first real job under my watch.
699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 successMessageT: Good. Functional gear, properly sourced. I prefer operators who understand quality control. Keep this up and you’ll stay useful.
699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 startedMessageT: You’re looking for clean hardware — working components only. If it wasn’t recovered during an operation, it’s worthless to me.
699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 completePlayerM: Everything you asked for. All recovered in raid.
6848f1776be936dd22573866 description: Wars are not won by accuracy. They are won by whoever reloads last. Tony prepares for long fights, not lucky shots. Extended magazines are becoming scarce, and operators working under him need sustained firepower to stay alive. Acquire high-capacity magazines and deliver them intact. Ammunition wins battles, but preparation wins wars.
6848f1776be936dd22573866 successMessageT: Good. More rounds before silence. Prapor counts rifles… I count ammunition. Guess who survives longer.
6848f1776be936dd22573866 startedMessageT: Standard magazines are for short fights. We plan for longer ones. Bring me capacity.

684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b description: Noise reveals truth. Factory strips away distance, comfort, and hesitation. Anyone can look competent behind cover — I want to know how you behave when steel screams and decisions must be instant. Enter Factory and prove you can function under pressure. Professionals do not panic.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b startedMessageT: Factory teaches honesty. Tight corridors, loud machinery, nowhere to hide mistakes. Show me you remain calm when others rush.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b successMessageT: You didn’t freeze. Many do. Panic ruins more operators than bullets ever could. You work clean — that makes you valuable.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b declinePlayerMe: Pressure exposes weakness. Decide whether you have the stomach for this work.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b failMessageText: Hesitation is expensive. Try again when you are ready to think clearly.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b note: Eliminate PMCs on Factory to prove combat composure.
